tools.name: analyze_account
tools.description: Comprehensive account overview: balance, resources, staking, voting, permissions, and delegations in a single call

tools.name: analyze_transfer_cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost of a TRX or TRC20 transfer: energy, bandwidth, and TRX burn options

tools.name: decode_abi_output
tools.description: Decode ABI-encoded output hex from a contract call. Handles return values, revert reasons (Error(string)), and panic codes (Panic(uint256)).

tools.name: delegate_resource

tools.name: estimate_energy
tools.description: Estimate energy cost for a smart contract call. Requires a full node with vm.supportConstant=true and vm.estimateEnergy=true; falls back to secondary node if primary does not support it.

tools.name: estimate_trc20_energy
tools.description: Estimate energy cost for a TRC20 transfer without creating a transaction. Dry-runs the transfer to check energy requirements.

tools.name: freeze_balance
tools.description: Stake TRX for energy or bandwidth (Stake 2.0). Returns unsigned transaction hex for signing.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get TRON account balance and details including TRX balance, bandwidth, energy, frozen resources, and account type

tools.name: get_account_permissions
tools.description: Get the permission structure of a TRON account including owner, active, and witness permissions with multi-sig keys and thresholds

tools.name: get_account_resources
tools.description: Get energy and bandwidth usage and limits for a TRON account

tools.name: get_bandwidth_prices
tools.description: Get current and historical bandwidth prices on the TRON network

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Get a TRON block by number or latest. Use include_transactions to get transaction details with decoded contract data (sender, receiver, amounts) and pagination.

tools.name: get_chain_parameters
tools.description: Get TRON network node info and current energy/bandwidth prices

tools.name: get_contract_abi
tools.description: Get the ABI of a smart contract on TRON. Automatically resolves proxy contracts (ERC-1967). Note: many TRON contracts are deployed without on-chain ABI — if empty, check TronScan for verified source code.

tools.name: get_contract_events
tools.description: Get decoded events emitted by a smart contract via TronGrid REST API. Returns a compact summary per event. Use a small limit and paginate with fingerprint to control response size

tools.name: get_delegatable_amount
tools.description: Get the maximum amount of energy or bandwidth an account can still delegate

tools.name: get_delegated_resources
tools.description: Get resources delegated to and from an account (Stake 2.0 delegation info)

tools.name: get_energy_prices
tools.description: Get current and historical energy prices on the TRON network

tools.name: get_network
tools.description: Get current MCP server connection info: network name, node address, and latest block

tools.name: get_pending_by_address
tools.description: Get pending transactions for a specific address from the mempool

tools.name: get_pending_transactions
tools.description: List pending transaction IDs and pool size from the mempool

tools.name: get_pq_capabilities
tools.description: Report which TIP-899 post-quantum signature schemes the connected node enables and this build can sign (FN-DSA-512 needs the gotron-mcp-pq build). TIP-899 is a draft live only on Nile. can_sign reflects the node and this build; signing also needs local mode with a keystore.

tools.name: get_proposal
tools.description: Get full details of a governance proposal by ID, including the complete list of approval addresses.

tools.name: get_token_price
tools.description: Get the current USD price of TRX or a TRC20 token. Uses CoinGecko with caching.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Get transaction details by transaction ID

tools.name: get_transaction_history
tools.description: Get transaction history for a TRON address via TronGrid REST API. Returns a compact summary per transaction. Use a small limit and paginate with fingerprint to control response size

tools.name: get_trc20_allowance
tools.description: Query how many tokens a spender is approved to transfer on behalf of the owner. Flags unlimited approvals as high risk.

tools.name: get_trc20_balance
tools.description: Get TRC20 token balance for an account

tools.name: get_trc20_token_info
tools.description: Get TRC20 token metadata (name, symbol, decimals, total supply)

tools.name: get_trc20_transfers
tools.description: Get TRC20 token transfer history for a TRON address via TronGrid REST API. Returns a compact summary per transfer with token info. Use a small limit and paginate with fingerprint to control response size

tools.name: is_transaction_pending
tools.description: Check if a specific transaction is still in the pending pool (mempool)

tools.name: list_contract_methods
tools.description: Get a human-readable summary of a smart contract's methods with signatures, inputs, outputs, and mutability. Auto-resolves proxy contracts.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: List governance proposals on the TRON network with pagination support. Returns a compact summary per proposal (use get_proposal for full details including approval addresses). Newest first by default.

tools.name: list_witnesses
tools.description: List super representatives (witnesses) on the TRON network with pagination support.

tools.name: revoke_approval
tools.description: Build unsigned transaction to revoke a TRC20 token approval (sets allowance to 0)

tools.name: transfer_trc20
tools.description: Create an unsigned TRC20 token transfer transaction. Returns transaction hex for signing.

tools.name: transfer_trx
tools.description: Create an unsigned TRX transfer transaction. Returns transaction hex for signing.

tools.name: trigger_constant_contract
tools.description: Call a read-only (view/pure) smart contract method. No transaction created, no fees. Returns decoded result. Provide either method+params OR data (pre-packed calldata).

tools.name: trigger_contract
tools.description: Call a smart contract method. Returns unsigned transaction hex for signing. Provide either method+params OR data (pre-packed calldata).

tools.name: undelegate_resource
tools.description: Reclaim previously delegated energy or bandwidth (Stake 2.0). Returns unsigned transaction hex for signing.

tools.name: unfreeze_balance
tools.description: Unstake TRX (Stake 2.0). Returns unsigned transaction hex for signing. Note: unstaked TRX has a 14-day withdrawal period.

tools.name: validate_address
tools.description: Validate a TRON address and convert supported inputs to TRON base58/hex. Accepts base58 (T...), TRON hex (41...), or Ethereum/EVM format (0x...).

tools.name: vote_witness
tools.description: Vote for super representatives. Returns unsigned transaction hex for signing. Requires staked TRX (1 TRX staked = 1 vote).

tools.name: withdraw_expire_unfreeze
tools.description: Withdraw TRX that has completed the 14-day unstaking period (Stake 2.0). Returns unsigned transaction hex for signing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_pq_capabilities · Private data: get_token_price, get_trc20_allowance, get_trc20_balance, get_trc20_token_info, get_trc20_transfers, revoke_approval, transfer_trc20 · Public sink: get_pq_capabilities · Destructive: validate_address.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_pq_capabilities · Private data: get_token_price, get_trc20_allowance, get_trc20_balance, get_trc20_token_info, get_trc20_transfers, revoke_approval, transfer_trc20 · Public sink: get_pq_capabilities · Destructive: validate_address

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
